item.title: Settlement concerns prompt Euronext to halt CoinShares’ Zcash ETP ahead of debut
item.description: A Euronext spokesperson told Cointelegraph the suspension was due to “operational settlement requirements” and remains in effect until settlement operations are supported by the CSD.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Mirae Asset Securities issues tokenized notes on Solana
item.description: The company’s Hong Kong unit issued six-month notes under its $3 billion program, extending blockchain-based distribution to institutional investors.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Bitcoin price eyes $82K as Morgan Stanley strategist says most of correction is over
item.description: Bitcoin sought to rebuild support at $80,000 while Asian and US tech stocks extended a rebound into key corporate earnings releases.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows climb to $176M as BTC rebounds above $80K
item.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $286 million over two days, narrowing October’s net outflows to $26 million as the Crypto Fear & Greed Index remained neutral.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Coinbase denies systems breach, says vendor exposed customer data
item.description: Coinbase said that an incident at analytics vendor Amplitude exposed some customers’ contact data, but it found no evidence of unauthorized access to its own systems.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Robinhood’s Tenev warns US tokenization uncertainty deters ‘serious assets’
item.description: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev says tokenized equities need more than a temporary SEC exemption to flourish in the US.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Bithumb discloses data leak after internal system breach: Report
item.description: The breach impacted its in-house mobile system, used by employees for work and information sharing.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Discord is making public chats searchable on Google: How to opt out
item.description: Discord conversations on large public servers will soon reach audiences far beyond their communities, raising privacy concerns.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: VanEck launches diversified ETF combining stocks, bonds and Bitcoin exposure
item.description: VanEck’s new Wealth Builder ETF targets a 2% Bitcoin allocation, with a permitted range of 1% to 5%, gaining exposure through a spot Bitcoin ETP.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Intel, IBM, Oracle and IonQ latest to object to OKX-ICE tokenized stocks
item.description: More than 40% of the companies initially proposed to have their stocks listed in tokenized form have asked to opt-out.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Quantum fears already limiting Bitcoin’s growth, Stacks founder says
item.description: Speaking on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction podcast, Muneeb Ali warned that uncertainty over Bitcoin’s quantum security could deter institutional investors.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Ripple, Robinhood expand partnership to bring RLUSD to retail and institutional markets
item.description: Ripple also expanded its collaboration with BNY on digital asset custody and partnered with C2FO to bring trade finance settlement onto the XRP Ledger.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: CFTC sues Utah to block action against prediction markets
item.description: The US state filed a lawsuit against Kalshi last week, seeking to recover up to $60 million in profits related to event contracts on prediction markets.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Majority of Americans want candidates who support US-based financial technology: Poll
item.description: The September survey offered a possible window into US voters who could consider fintech and digital asset policies on Election Day.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Janus Henderson, Centrifuge launch tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar
item.description: The blockchain-based fund offers eligible non-US investors exposure to the Nasdaq-100 as Janus Henderson expands its institutional tokenization business.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: USDC overtakes USDT in euro stablecoin trading as EU rules reshape market: Kaiko
item.description: USDC’s share of euro stablecoin trading has climbed to 56% since January 2024, with deeper liquidity as exchanges restrict USDT under MiCA.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Crypto could outperform AI stocks: Wall Street veteran Jordi Visser
item.description: Former Morgan Stanley and Weiss executive Jordi Visser says AI agents are boosting demand for crypto as he expands his holdings beyond Bitcoin, Ether and Solana.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Hayes details FLOP’s AI compute derivatives vision after selling his altcoins
item.description: Arthur Hayes revealed the derivatives market design for Flop Network and how he expects its native token could transform AI compute into a tradable commodity.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Luxor raises $16M from CMT Digital amid AI-Bitcoin miner convergence
item.description: Luxor aims to use the proceeds to scale its existing AI infrastructure business and expand its GPU sourcing services as global chip supply chains become constrained.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin price analysis sees ‘strong rally’ as old coins become dormant
item.description: A decline in the share of Bitcoin’s realized cap held by coins unmoved for 18 months or longer points to the ‘early stages’ of a bull market, analysis says.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Zcash co-founder calls to stop funding ‘over $125M’ grants program
item.description: Sean Bowe says ZCG has enough money to keep funding projects and wants its share of new ZEC redirected to a reserve for the network.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bloom bot hackers loot $953K faster than you can microwave popcorn
item.description: Bloom pledged to reimburse nine traders after $953,000 was drained from 48 wallets, saying no private keys were accessed or compromised.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Binance files for Brazil crypto license ahead of Friday deadline
item.description: The exchange is delisting 22 crypto assets for Brazilian users and hopes talks with the central bank will allow it to restore some services.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs claw back $110M after $774M exit
item.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs remained in the red for October, with about $202 million in net outflows for the month despite Monday’s rebound.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: RedotPay weighs confidential US IPO filing by year-end: Bloomberg
item.description: The stablecoin payments company previously disputed reports that its US listing had been delayed.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Keystone breach deepens: Hackers stole key used to verify wallets as genuine
item.description: Keystone initially disclosed a leak of customer information but has since disclosed that hackers also stole a key that could allow counterfeit wallets to pass authenticity checks.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Ripple wins final US approval for national trust bank
item.description: The approval clears the way for Ripple to manage reserves backing its RLUSD stablecoin and provide digital asset custody.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: US OCC calls on community banks to become payment stablecoin issuers
item.description: The announcement followed the banking regulator finalizing its rules for the GENIUS Act, a stablecoin law to be implemented in January
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
item.description: The new index tracks rental prices for five Nvidia GPUs, offering leveraged trading and potential hedging against fluctuations in AI computing costs.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar
